final_answer:
**Amazon's total revenue (net sales) for fiscal year 2024 was $637,959 million (~$638.0 billion).**

- Source: Amazon.com, Inc. Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 (accession 0001018724-25-000004), Consolidated Statements of Operations [DOC-1].
- The figure reported is: "Net sales, fiscal year 2024: $637,959" (in millions) [DOC-1].

Comparability note: This is a single-period figure drawn directly from Amazon's own FY2024 10-K, covering a full 12-month fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, so no cross-entity, fiscal-year, or accounting-basis adjustment is required. For context, the same statement reports net sales of $574,785 million in FY2023 and $513,983 million in FY2022 [DOC-1], both presented on the same basis as comparatives within the FY2024 filing; the excerpt does not disclose any restatements, divestitures, or segment redefinitions affecting these figures.

ANSWER: $637,959 million (approximately $638.0 billion) in net sales for fiscal year 2024
